profile.headline: Software Engineer in Test at Equifax

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Build and maintain test automation for the ACAMS application on the ACA QE Automation team, using Behave (BDD) and Playwright with Python.

- Write BDD test scenarios in Gherkin with Behave, so test cases read as plain-language business requirements that QA, developers, and product owners can all follow.

- Develop Playwright UI automation for core ACAMS user workflows, with a focus on stable, reusable, and maintainable test code.

- Expand regression coverage to reduce manual testing effort and catch defects earlier in the release cycle.

- Work closely with developers and QA peers to turn requirements into automated acceptance tests.

- Apply AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot to speed up test authoring and failure triage.

positions.title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Objective: Replace manual end-to-end testing by fully automated, scalable solutions using Pytest, Playwright/Selenium, and CI/CD pipelines.

🔹 Architected and implemented scalable E2E automation frameworks using Pytest + Playwright/Selenium, significantly reducing manual testing effort
🔹 Applied AI Agent and AI-assisted (GitHub Copilot) techniques to develop testing framework, test script, analyze logs, test results, and system behavior, reducing root-cause analysis time and improving defect detection efficiency
🔹 Integrated automated test suites into Harness CI/CD pipelines with Docker containers, reducing release cycle time and minimizing deployment risk
🔹 Developed test reporting and alerting dashboards (Grafana + InfluxDB), enabling rapid defect detection and faster triage
🔹 Designed performance testing solutions using JMeter and API-driven scenarios, improving microservices performance and scalability under high load

positions.title: Senior Performance Engineer
positions.description:
🔹 Developed and maintained LoadRunner scripts to validate performance and scalability under high-load conditions
🔹 Built Jenkins pipelines to fully automate performance test execution and reporting
🔹 Designed and build ELK dashboards (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for real-time performance and analysis
🔹 Optimized test execution through automation, reducing runtime and increasing efficiency

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
🔹 Enhanced and support for reporting frameworks (Cognos) and tracking of production issues
🔹 Developed and maintained deployment and installation scripts for Customer Feedback software
